articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Tambov region, reportedly hitting infrastructure on Druzhba oil pipeline
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck Russia’s Tambov region overnight on October 20, sparking a fire at one of the facilities, the region’s governor, Yevgeny Pervyshev, said. He declined to elaborate, saying only that no one was injured.

articles.title_en: Russian retailers seek emergency operating rules for outages following data center attacks, plus permission to store data in ‘friendly’ countries
articles.lead_en: Russian retailers want a special legal regime that would take effect during mass outages in state information systems, known as GIS, according to the Russian business daily Kommersant. The proposal appears in a letter that the Association of Internet Trade Companies, or AKIT, sent to Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin.

articles.title_en: Three people killed in Russian attack on Kyiv region as rescuers search debris at industrial building
articles.lead_en: Russian forces struck a building used for manufacturing and storage in the Obukhiv district of Ukraine’s Kyiv region overnight on October 20. The building caught fire, the State Emergency Service said.
